title: 第九章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

他在部队训练，像这样的伤都是家常便饭。

时间久了，就有经验了。

“你行不行啊？”苏清荔见他要上手，有些慌乱地问。

傅谨严没吭声。

但却不容置喙按住她的脚轻轻揉了起来。

苏清荔只觉被他双手拂过的地方，疼痛慢慢消退了，就没再阻拦。

从医院出来后，天已经黑了。

而刘红英自从上次见到苏清荔后，不知为何，对她就十分在意。

这次从副官口中知道傅谨严带着苏清荔去医院后，就早早等到门外。

见两人出来后，刘红英做出焦急的表情：

“我听说清荔受伤了，怎么样了？”

苏清荔有些意外她大老远跑一趟，但想到她和傅谨严的关系，就有些明白了。

“一点小伤，不碍事。”

话虽如此，刘红英见她被傅谨严背着，姿势分外亲密，抿了抿唇，语气善解人意地说，“谨严，你累了一天，要不我来扶清荔吧。”

“好啊。”苏清荔头一次看刘红英这么顺眼，当即挣扎着就要下来。

“别动！”傅谨严呵斥苏清荔一声，而后才对刘红英说，“她太重，你身子弱，万一让她伤着就不好了。”

苏清荔被他双标快要气吐血了。

什么叫怕她把刘红英压坏了？

她一直有在做身材管理好不好！

听到这话，刘红英心中那点介意散开来。

来时的路上，她从副官口中得知，苏清荔不是傅谨严亲妹妹，而是他继母带过来的，心中还有点不舒服。

但见傅谨严这样关心自己，她放下心。

“清荔，这几天你要是有什么不方便的地方，就告诉我，我来帮你。”

苏清荔没把这番客套话放在心上。

傅谨严却听出她的言外之意。

“你工作的地方离军区那么远，来回跑太麻烦了。”

刘红英却笑着说：“有件事我还没告诉你，我打算把广播员工作辞了换个工作。”

说到这，她看了一眼苏清荔。

“说起来，我和清荔还很有缘呢，都去报了文工团。”

傅谨严眉头皱得更紧。

He was training in the army, and injuries like this were commonplace.

Over time, you gain experience.

"Are you okay?" Seeing that he was about to take action, Su Qingli asked in a panic.

Fu Jinyan remained silent.

But he didn't hesitate to hold her feet down and rub them gently.

Su Qingli felt the pain slowly subsided in the place where his hands had brushed her, and she didn't stop her anymore.

After coming out of the hospital, it was already dark.

And Liu Hongying has been very concerned about Su Qingli for some reason since she last saw her.

This time, after learning from the adjutant that Fu Jinyan was taking Su Qingli to the hospital, he waited outside the door early.

After seeing the two people come out, Liu Hongying made an anxious expression:

"I heard Qingli was injured, how is it?"

Su Qingli was a little surprised that she came all the way, but when she thought about her relationship with Fu Jinyan, she understood a little bit.

"A small injury, it doesn't matter."

Having said that, Liu Hongying saw that Fu Jinyan was carrying her in an extremely intimate posture. She pursed her lips and said in an empathetic tone, "Jinyan, you have been tired for a long day. How about I come and help Qingli."

"Okay." It was the first time Su Qingli saw Liu Hongying so pleasing to her eyes, and she immediately struggled to get off.

"Don't move!" Fu Jinyan scolded Su Qingli, and then said to Liu Hongying, "She is too heavy and you are weak. It would be bad if she gets hurt."

Su Qingli was so angry that he almost vomited blood because of his double standard.

Why are you afraid that she will crush Liu Hongying?

She has been doing body management, okay?

Hearing this, Liu Hongying's worries disappeared.

On the way here, she learned from the adjutant that Su Qingli was not Fu Jinyan's biological sister, but was brought here by his stepmother, and she felt a little uncomfortable.

But seeing Fu Jinyan caring about her so much, she felt relieved.

"Qingli, if you have any inconvenience these days, just tell me and I will help you."

Su Qingli didn't take these polite words to heart.

Fu Jinyan heard the implication behind her words.

"The place where you work is so far away from the military area. It's too troublesome to travel back and forth."

But Liu Hongying said with a smile: "There is something I haven't told you yet. I plan to quit my job as a broadcaster and find another job."

Speaking of this, she glanced at Su Qingli.

"Speaking of which, Qingli and I have a close relationship. We both signed up for the art troupe."

Fu Jinyan frowned even more tightly.
